1: # ARCHITECTURE — Full New Backend + Frontend Logic
2: 
3: Replaces the old tRPC + regex-decision + god-class backend. The system becomes:
4: 
5: ```
6: Browser (Next.js client, zustand stores)
7:    │  useChat (Vercel AI SDK @ai-sdk/react 4.x)
8:    ▼
9: /workspace/[threadId]   (client page, no full reload on threadId swap)
10:    │
11:    ▼  POST /api/chat (ChatTransport → streamText)
12:    │
13:    ├── live (fast) tools: askUserQuestion, showPlan, editPlan, memory tools,
14:    │                      HTTP request tool, media tools (image/transcription live)
15:    │
16:    └── durable (Anakin/Inngest) tools: delegateAgenticWork (one tool)
17:                │
18:                ▼  inngest.send("thread/run")
19:                ▼  Inngest fn "thread-runner" streams run_activities rows
20:                ▼  Supabase Realtime → ChatMessage updates live in place
21: ```
22: 
23: ## A. Auth (Supabase, Google only, MVP)
24: 
25: - Root `page.tsx` = login screen. `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:"google"})`.
26: - `onLinkIdentity`/redirect to `/workspace` after signup.
27: - Post-signup flow: pre-questions driven by a JSON config (role/usecase/goal,
28:   multi+single select; user edits the JSON, app maps it to QuestionFlow). Answers
29:   → `user_profiles.pre_answers`. If signup exists but profile row missing → auto
30:   navigate to onboarding (create on demand).
31: - `useSupabaseUser()` hook (zustand + Supabase client). Middleware/proxy
32:   (`src/proxy.ts` evlog) still runs; tRPC session shim removed — server routes
33:   read `createServerClient` session from cookies.
34: - Sessions: Supabase handles refresh (`@supabase/ssr` cookie-based). Server
35:   side: `createServerClient` with anon/publishable; protected route checks user.
36: 
37: ## B. Realtime plumbing
38: 
39: - **Supabase Realtime** on tables: `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
40:   `approval_requests`, `notifications` (private channels, JWT-auth user filters).
41: - Client hooks: `useChatRealtime(threadId)` merges live broadcast rows into the
42:   chat store / useChat message list. **This is how Inngest-produced activity
43:   reaches the UI** (durable work streams to an open chat).
44: - Room id convention `thread:{threadId}` on Realtime channel.
45: 
46: ## C. Chat transport & message appending (the "no new message every tool" rule)
47: 
48: Streaming in web via `POST /api/chat` using `ChatTransport` protocol:
49: - Drive `messages` from DB via `chat_messages`, feed to `streamText`.
50: - **Live LLM path**: `streamText({model, messages, tools, toolApproval,
51:   stopWhen: isStepCount(maxSteps), system: composeSystem(workflow, plan, memory)})`
52:   → `toUIMessageStream` → `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. Returns typed
53:   `UIMessage` parts; `useChat`/`Chat` client keeps ONE assistant message alive
54:   and appends tool parts to it.
55: - **Durable path**: when a tool needs Inngest (Anakin, browser, sleep/schedule),
56:   the route/handler calls `inngest.send("thread/run", …)` and returns a
57:   "delegated" tool part with the `run_id`; UI shows ThinkingSteps derived from
58:   `run_activities` streamed in. When the run completes, the ChatMessage gets a
59:   final assistant part (result text). No new message bubbles for sub-steps —
60:   everything appends to the same assistant message.
61: - **New ChatMessage(assistant) triggers** ONLY: error, warning, workflow stops
62:   unexpectedly, user stops → user clicks Run again. (Per user rule.)
63: 
64: ```tsx
65: // client pseudocode — the appending contract
66: const { messages, sendMessage, addToolResult, stop } = useChat({ api: "/api/chat", id: threadId });
67: // useChat actually uses Chat/DefaultChatTransport — bridge in provider
68: ```
69: 
70: ## D. Tool surface (LLM-invocable, zod schemas, NEVER hardcoded)
71: 
72: | Tool | When | Runs |
73: |---|---|---|
74: | `askQuestion` | clarifying questions (any time LLM needs) | live — returns `AskUserQuestion[]` JSON → UI renders ask-user-questions (MCQ) |
75: | `showPlan` | ONLY when user explicitly asks to plan/workflow (NO auto-plan) | live — returns `{steps: [...], header}` → AccordionGroup |
76: | `editPlan` | add/remove/update any step | live — persists `plan_steps` |
77: | `finalizeAndInject` | user approves → bind thread↔workflow, set status | live + sends thread/run if "run" chosen |
78: | `bindWorkflow` (variant) | approve-but-not-run | live — bind only, workflow idle; Run button appears, Stop hidden. Run toggles→Stop while running |
79: | `storeMemory` / `searchMemory` | thread + global memory (mem0) | live (mem0 low-latency); ONE mem0 store per user, thread scoped by metadata |
80: | `httpRequest` | user bearer token, arbitrary HTTP | live — raw fetch; https-only, private-IP blocked, size/max-redirect caps |
81: | `delegateAgenticWork` | ANY Anakin capability (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire/browser + schedule) | durable → Inngest `thread/run`; returns run_id |
82: | `generateImage` / `transcribeAudio` | media generation requests | live when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` set per workspace/env |
83: 
84: - `askQuestion` → `AskUserQuestion` schema (packages/ui
85:   `ask-user-questions.tsx:37`) — single zod schema shared server+client.
86: - Auto-approve switch: toolApproval config + `approval_requests` row status
87:   auto-"approved" when workflow.auto_approve; system message emitted
88:   "auto-approved via settings".
89: - **NO auto-plan/wiring**: LLM answers plain text, never auto-creates a plan or
90:   binds a workflow on its own. `showPlan` only fires after user explicitly asks
91:   ("create a workflow / plan this"). A 2nd user message is NOT a plan trigger.
92: - **Attachments → LLM-readable**: image/pdf/video dropped into ChatComposer get
93:   converted to LLM input parts (image → data URL / base64 image part; pdf →
94:   extracted text part) before the call; media tools return real content.
95: 
96: ## E. Durable execution (Inngest): `thread/run`
97: 
98: - ONE event: `thread/run` (down from pile). `thread-runner` function:
99:   1. fetch everything from DB (thread, plan, memory summaries, previous runs).
100:   2. `generateText`/`ToolLoopAgent` with the SAME tool set minus the durable
101:      re-delegation (no recursion);
102:   3. persist each step/tool into `runs` + `run_activities` + broadcast.
103:   4. sleep/resume via `runs.status=sleeping` + schedule-tick (FIXED: add proper
104:      Inngest `triggers: [{ event:... }]` or `cron`) — and register ALL functions
105:      in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` serve list.
106:   5. notify on completion/failure → `notifications`.
107: - Idempotency: `runs.status` gate `pending→running` with `select … for update`
108:   in Postgres; retries honor existing activity instead of re-running.
109: - Cost caps: check BEFORE each step (realtime), not after the run (fix the
110:   old post-hoc bug).
111: 
112: ## F. Frontend state (zustand)
113: 
114: - Zustand stores (each `[thread]`, `[sidebar]`, `[chatComposer]`, `[ui/theme]`,
115:   `[auth]`) — keeps server components pure; zustand used max; no useState sprawl.
116: - `threadId` navigation: Next.js `router.push('/workspace/'+id, { scroll:false })`
117:   updating only param; page reads `params.threadId` once → store. ChatComposer
118:   layout: centered when no messages → bottom once first message exists.
119: - ChatComposer: queue (ordered, editable, removable, durable-backend),
120:   token-quality slider formula: `maxTokens per CHAT request` (this is what the
121:   slider means; maps to `streamText.maxOutputTokens`, not a run budget),
122:   file/image/pdf attach → compress (canvas, WebP, quality 0.8, max 2000px) →
123:   Supabase Storage → `files` row + `UIMessage` attachments.
124: - Queue `chat_messages.status=queued`: on run finish, drain SEQUENTIALLY —
125:   deliver message, wait for that response to finish, then next (no parallel
126:   queue burst). Edited/reordered queue → DB rows updated in place, order kept.
127: 
128: ## G. Memory (mem0, ONE place per user, thread-scoped)
129: 
130: - ONE mem0 store per app user (as chosen): every thread's memories live there,
131:   scoped by `metadata.threadId`. `storeMemory`/`searchMemory` tools:
132:   - thread scope: `{scope:"thread", threadId}` — memories only reprompted for
133:     that thread.
134:   - global scope: `{scope:"global"}` — **program-given memory injected
135:     beforehand**, works across ALL workspaces/threads/apps for that user (not
136:     per-workspace). E.g. capability schemas, user prefs, standing instructions.
137: - `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1` resolution: adapter schemas exposed
138:   to LLM via GLOBAL memory (per decision) — one tool `listCapabilities` returns
139:   schemas; keeps them OO-reflectable.
140: 
141: ## I. Permission model — invites, roles, sharing (locked answers)
142: 
143: ### Role set (ONE model everywhere)
144: `owner | editor | viewer` — **no admin**. | Action | owner | editor | viewer | thread-guest |
145: |---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
146: | rename / delete workspace, keys, settings | ✅ | — | — | — |
147: | manage members (invite/role/remove) | ✅ | — | — | — |
148: | create / rename / delete groups & threads | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
149: | edit plans, bind workflows | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
150: | send msgs, run/stop, approve approvals | ✅ | ✅ | — | ✅ |
151: | view history / runs / plan | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
152: | rename / rebind / re-share / delete shared thread | ✅ | — | — | — |
153: > thread-guest = the person invited to a SPECIFIC thread (thread share). Editor
154: > = member of the shared workspace.
155: 
156: ### Workspace invite (join the REAL workspace)
157: 1. Owner (only) copies workspace invite link / shares by email → `invites` row
158:    (`kind=workspace`, role editor|viewer chosen at invite).
159: 2. Invitee accepts → `workspace_members` row (role as invited). NO copy, no new
160:    workspace — it's the owner's actual workspace. Workspace appears in the
161:    invitee's top-left switcher (badge on the button) → switching in shows ALL
162:    groups + threads (all members see everything).
163: 3. Members chat/run using the **workspace's keys** (owner pays) UNLESS profile
164:    toggle "use my own keys in invited workspaces" is on → member's own
165:    workspace keys are used. `get_workspace_key` RPC + key-service honor this.
166: 4. Owner can change roles / remove / revoke anytime. Editor can delete any
167:    thread/group (even others'). Viewer read-only.
168: 
169: ### Thread share (guest in YOUR sidebar)
170: 1. Owner toggles `threads.share_enabled` and copies the thread share link
171:    (per-thread; the "list of my threads + switch" UI in Members/Share).
172: 2. Invitee accepts → `thread_shares` row. The LIVE SAME thread (not a copy)
173:    appears in the invitee's OWN workspace sidebar under the **INVITES system
174:    group** (created locked+empty at signup; only fills via accepted invites),
175:    with a Badge on the thread button and on the header. Both users
176:    chat in the same realtime thread.
177: 3. Invitee's messages use **their own keys**; their name shows on user bubbles.
178: 4. Owner revokes by flipping share_enabled / deleting the share.
179: 
180: ### Keys resolution order (chat / run)
181: ```
182: 1. member in a shared workspace + prefer_own_keys_in_shared=true
183:       → member's OWN Personal workspace keys (type: groq|anakin|mem0|…)
184: 2. workspace keys (the workspace the thread belongs to)
185: 3. env defaults (ANAKIN_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / MEM0_API_KEY / models)
186: ```
187: 
188: ## J. Packages map (rewrite targets)
189: 
190: | Package | Old | New |
191: |---|---|---|
192: | `@aevryn/auth` | better-auth | Supabase client + SSR + google + onboarding trigger |
193: | `@aevryn/api` | tRPC router | dropped for chat (chat = `POST /api/chat`); keep minimal health/metadata route if needed |
194: | `@aevryn/agent` | runtime + registry + regex | `runAgent` live (streamText), durable `thread-runner`, tools from schema library |
195: | `@aevryn/workflow` | god service 66 methods | split: thread-service, plan-service, run-service, activity-service, notification-service, key-service, **member-service** (invites, roles, shares) |
196: | `@aevryn/inngest` | 3 functions, 1 served | serve ALL fns; `thread-runner` + `schedule-tick` (Inngest cron) + notify |
197: | `@aevryn/db` | 16 tables legacy | new SCHEMA.md (17 tables) + Supabase migration |
198: | `@aevryn/env` | server only | server + web split, USER keys via DB Vault (see ENV.md) |
199: | `@aevryn/ui` | components (keep) | real-data wiring (dropdown, nav, dialogs), ChatMessage attachments, ProfileDialog, Toaster mount |
200: 
201: ## K. Flow verification scenarios (must "just work")
202: 
203: 1. **"Hi"** → user text only, LLM plain text, NO tool call, NO new workflow.
204: 2. **"plan me a laptop comparison"** → LLM askQuestion (MCQ) → user answers →
205:    showPlan accordion → workflowApproval (approve/decline/bind/run) → bind →
206:    `thread/run` → ThinkingSteps stream research/scrape sub-tasks into the SAME
207:    assistant message → final answer text appended.
208: 3. **"scrape X.com profile" (no plan)** → delegateAgenticWork → durable run →
209:    run_activities stream → final text in same message.
210: 4. **user closes tab mid-run** → run continues in Inngest; reopening
211:    workspace reloads `chat_messages` + `run_activities` → renders state.
212: 5. **queued "delete workflow" while run active** → message queued durable;
213:    once run completes → queued delivered SEQUENTIALLY (wait each).
214: 6. **auto-approve ON** → approval resolves instantly + system message.
215: 7. **workspace invite** → invitee opens link, accepts → workspace in switcher
216:    (badge), ALL threads visible, chats charge workspace keys (owner) unless
217:    invitee's "use my own keys" toggle → own keys.
218: 8. **thread share** → owner toggles share, guest accepts → SAME live thread in
219:    guest's INVITES group + header badge, guest chats with OWN keys + name on
220:    bubbles, cannot edit plan/rename; owner revoke removes access instantly.
221: 9. **deleted thread** → soft-archive 30 days (trash), recover → live;
222:    after 30 days hard-delete (incl. runs/activities/files).
223: 10. **"re-run last run"** → play a rerun (trigger=rerun) with same plan, no
224:     new chat; hits new `runs` row, streams activities again.
225: 11. **first message** → auto-titles thread; title editable after.
226: 
227: ## L. Non-goals / pinned decisions
228: - Markdown rendering: FUTURE (write API to be parser-friendly — parts, no
229:   prose-heavy gating). Output contract ready for it.
230: - Media generation: IMAGE + TRANSCRIPTION SHIPPED in MVP (lazy-load provider
231:   when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` configured); SPEECH/VIDEO stay schemas
232:   only until models exist. Attachments always converted to LLM-readable parts.
233: - Sub-agents in parallel: FUTURE phase (see FEATURES.md); design tool outputs as
234:   containers so sub-agent results merge into `run_activities`.
235: - Creating MULTIPLE owned workspaces: FUTURE (pro tier). MVP = 1 owned
236:   Personal + unlimited JOINED workspaces (via invite).
237: - Shared-thread plan editing by guests: OFF (owner/editor only).
238: 
239: ## Product features (locked in docs; see NOTES "Decisions" & PLAN.md)
240: 1. **Soft-archive delete**: deleting a thread/workflow sets `threads.deleted_at`;
241:    recoverable 30 days (trash), then hard-delete incl. Storage. Never silent.
242: 2. **Smart auto-title**: thread title automatically set from the first user
243:    message (truncated); rename still available. No blank "New thread".
244: 3. **One Run mental model**: Run button AND the LLM both fire `thread/run`
245:    (same event). WorkflowApproval dialog = max 4 buttons: Approve+Run /
246:    Approve / Decline / Edit plan. No dead dropdowns.
247: 4. **Model presets**: Agent/Env tab shows a per-provider list of known model
248:    ids (searchable) + free-text override; picks write `workspace_api_keys.model_name`.
249: 5. **Share preview page**: share link lands on a preview (thread title + owner
250:    name only, NO content) with Accept — content stays private until accepted.
251: 6. **Export/import thread**: single JSON (plan + steps + key messages,
252:    keys stripped) for export/import — template/reuse path.
253: 7. **Re-run**: from a past Run play a rerun with the same plan, no new chat
254:    (`runs.rerun_of`, trigger=rerun).

(End of file - total 254 lines)
</content>

  stopWhen: isStepCount(maxSteps), system: composeSystem(workflow, plan, memory)})`
  → `toUIMessageStream` → `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. Returns typed
  `UIMessage` parts; `useChat`/`Chat` client keeps ONE assistant message alive
  and appends tool parts to it.
- **Durable path**: when a tool needs Inngest (Anakin, browser, sleep/schedule),
  the route/handler calls `inngest.send("thread/run", …)` and returns a
  "delegated" tool part with the `run_id`; UI shows ThinkingSteps derived from
  `run_activities` streamed in. When the run completes, the ChatMessage gets a
  final assistant part (result text). No new message bubbles for sub-steps —
  everything appends to the same assistant message.
- **New ChatMessage(assistant) triggers** ONLY: error, warning, workflow stops
  unexpectedly, user stops → user clicks Run again. (Per user rule.)

```tsx
// client pseudocode — the appending contract
const { messages, sendMessage, addToolResult, stop } = useChat({ api: "/api/chat", id: threadId });
// useChat actually uses Chat/DefaultChatTransport — bridge in provider
```

## D. Tool surface (LLM-invocable, zod schemas, NEVER hardcoded)

| Tool | When | Runs |
|---|---|---|
| `askQuestion` | clarifying questions (any time LLM needs) | live — returns `AskUserQuestion[]` JSON → UI renders ask-user-questions (MCQ) |
| `showPlan` | ONLY when user explicitly asks to plan/workflow (NO auto-plan) | live — returns `{steps: [...], header}` → AccordionGroup |
| `editPlan` | add/remove/update any step | live — persists `plan_steps` |
| `finalizeAndInject` | user approves → bind thread↔workflow, set status | live + sends thread/run if "run" chosen |
| `bindWorkflow` (variant) | approve-but-not-run | live — bind only, workflow idle; Run button appears, Stop hidden. Run toggles→Stop while running |
| `storeMemory` / `searchMemory` | thread + global memory (mem0) | live (mem0 low-latency); ONE mem0 store per user, thread scoped by metadata |
| `httpRequest` | user bearer token, arbitrary HTTP | live — raw fetch; https-only, private-IP blocked, size/max-redirect caps |
| `delegateAgenticWork` | ANY Anakin capability (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire/browser + schedule) | durable → Inngest `thread/run`; returns run_id |
| `generateImage` / `transcribeAudio` | media generation requests | live when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` set per workspace/env |

- `askQuestion` → `AskUserQuestion` schema (packages/ui
  `ask-user-questions.tsx:37`) — single zod schema shared server+client.
- Auto-approve switch: toolApproval config + `approval_requests` row status
  auto-"approved" when workflow.auto_approve; system message emitted
  "auto-approved via settings".
- **NO auto-plan/wiring**: LLM answers plain text, never auto-creates a plan or
  binds a workflow on its own. `showPlan` only fires after user explicitly asks
  ("create a workflow / plan this"). A 2nd user message is NOT a plan trigger.
- **Attachments → LLM-readable**: image/pdf/video dropped into ChatComposer get
  converted to LLM input parts (image → data URL / base64 image part; pdf →
  extracted text part) before the call; media tools return real content.

## E. Durable execution (Inngest): `thread/run`

- ONE event: `thread/run` (down from pile). `thread-runner` function:
  1. fetch everything from DB (thread, plan, memory summaries, previous runs).
  2. `generateText`/`ToolLoopAgent` with the SAME tool set minus the durable
     re-delegation (no recursion);
  3. persist each step/tool into `runs` + `run_activities` + broadcast.
  4. sleep/resume via `runs.status=sleeping` + schedule-tick (FIXED: add proper
     Inngest `triggers: [{ event:... }]` or `cron`) — and register ALL functions
     in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` serve list.
  5. notify on completion/failure → `notifications`.
- Idempotency: `runs.status` gate `pending→running` with `select … for update`
  in Postgres; retries honor existing activity instead of re-running.
- Cost caps: check BEFORE each step (realtime), not after the run (fix the
  old post-hoc bug).

## F. Frontend state (zustand)

- Zustand stores (each `[thread]`, `[sidebar]`, `[chatComposer]`, `[ui/theme]`,
  `[auth]`) — keeps server components pure; zustand used max; no useState sprawl.
- `threadId` navigation: Next.js `router.push('/workspace/'+id, { scroll:false })`
  updating only param; page reads `params.threadId` once → store. ChatComposer
  layout: centered when no messages → bottom once first message exists.
- ChatComposer: queue (ordered, editable, removable, durable-backend),
  token-quality slider formula: `maxTokens per CHAT request` (this is what the
  slider means; maps to `streamText.maxOutputTokens`, not a run budget),
  file/image/pdf attach → compress (canvas, WebP, quality 0.8, max 2000px) →
  Supabase Storage → `files` row + `UIMessage` attachments.
- Queue `chat_messages.status=queued`: on run finish, drain SEQUENTIALLY —
  deliver message, wait for that response to finish, then next (no parallel
  queue burst). Edited/reordered queue → DB rows updated in place, order kept.

## G. Memory (mem0, ONE place per user, thread-scoped)

- ONE mem0 store per app user (as chosen): every thread's memories live there,
  scoped by `metadata.threadId`. `storeMemory`/`searchMemory` tools:
  - thread scope: `{scope:"thread", threadId}` — memories only reprompted for
    that thread.
  - global scope: `{scope:"global"}` — **program-given memory injected
    beforehand**, works across ALL workspaces/threads/apps for that user (not
    per-workspace). E.g. capability schemas, user prefs, standing instructions.
- `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1` resolution: adapter schemas exposed
  to LLM via GLOBAL memory (per decision) — one tool `listCapabilities` returns
  schemas; keeps them OO-reflectable.

## I. Permission model — invites, roles, sharing (locked answers)

### Role set (ONE model everywhere)
`owner | editor | viewer` — **no admin**. | Action | owner | editor | viewer | thread-guest |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| rename / delete workspace, keys, settings | ✅ | — | — | — |
| manage members (invite/role/remove) | ✅ | — | — | — |
| create / rename / delete groups & threads | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
| edit plans, bind workflows | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
| send msgs, run/stop, approve approvals | ✅ | ✅ | — | ✅ |
| view history / runs / plan | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| rename / rebind / re-share / delete shared thread | ✅ | — | — | — |
> thread-guest = the person invited to a SPECIFIC thread (thread share). Editor
> = member of the shared workspace.

### Workspace invite (join the REAL workspace)
1. Owner (only) copies workspace invite link / shares by email → `invites` row
   (`kind=workspace`, role editor|viewer chosen at invite).
2. Invitee accepts → `workspace_members` row (role as invited). NO copy, no new
   workspace — it's the owner's actual workspace. Workspace appears in the
   invitee's top-left switcher (badge on the button) → switching in shows ALL
   groups + threads (all members see everything).
3. Members chat/run using the **workspace's keys** (owner pays) UNLESS profile
   toggle "use my own keys in invited workspaces" is on → member's own
   workspace keys are used. `get_workspace_key` RPC + key-service honor this.
4. Owner can change roles / remove / revoke anytime. Editor can delete any
   thread/group (even others'). Viewer read-only.

### Thread share (guest in YOUR sidebar)
1. Owner toggles `threads.share_enabled` and copies the thread share link
   (per-thread; the "list of my threads + switch" UI in Members/Share).
2. Invitee accepts → `thread_shares` row. The LIVE SAME thread (not a copy)
   appears in the invitee's OWN workspace sidebar under the **INVITES system
   group** (created locked+empty at signup; only fills via accepted invites),
   with a Badge on the thread button and on the header. Both users
   chat in the same realtime thread.
3. Invitee's messages use **their own keys**; their name shows on user bubbles.
4. Owner revokes by flipping share_enabled / deleting the share.

### Keys resolution order (chat / run)
```
1. member in a shared workspace + prefer_own_keys_in_shared=true
      → member's OWN Personal workspace keys (type: groq|anakin|mem0|…)
2. workspace keys (the workspace the thread belongs to)
3. env defaults (ANAKIN_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / MEM0_API_KEY / models)
```

## J. Packages map (rewrite targets)

| Package | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| `@aevryn/auth` | better-auth | Supabase client + SSR + google + onboarding trigger |
| `@aevryn/api` | tRPC router | dropped for chat (chat = `POST /api/chat`); keep minimal health/metadata route if needed |
| `@aevryn/agent` | runtime + registry + regex | `runAgent` live (streamText), durable `thread-runner`, tools from schema library |
| `@aevryn/workflow` | god service 66 methods | split: thread-service, plan-service, run-service, activity-service, notification-service, key-service, **member-service** (invites, roles, shares) |
| `@aevryn/inngest` | 3 functions, 1 served | serve ALL fns; `thread-runner` + `schedule-tick` (Inngest cron) + notify |
| `@aevryn/db` | 16 tables legacy | new SCHEMA.md (17 tables) + Supabase migration |
| `@aevryn/env` | server only | server + web split, USER keys via DB Vault (see ENV.md) |
| `@aevryn/ui` | components (keep) | real-data wiring (dropdown, nav, dialogs), ChatMessage attachments, ProfileDialog, Toaster mount |

## K. Flow verification scenarios (must "just work")

1. **"Hi"** → user text only, LLM plain text, NO tool call, NO new workflow.
2. **"plan me a laptop comparison"** → LLM askQuestion (MCQ) → user answers →
   showPlan accordion → workflowApproval (approve/decline/bind/run) → bind →
   `thread/run` → ThinkingSteps stream research/scrape sub-tasks into the SAME
   assistant message → final answer text appended.
3. **"scrape X.com profile" (no plan)** → delegateAgenticWork → durable run →
   run_activities stream → final text in same message.
4. **user closes tab mid-run** → run continues in Inngest; reopening
   workspace reloads `chat_messages` + `run_activities` → renders state.
5. **queued "delete workflow" while run active** → message queued durable;
   once run completes → queued delivered SEQUENTIALLY (wait each).
6. **auto-approve ON** → approval resolves instantly + system message.
7. **workspace invite** → invitee opens link, accepts → workspace in switcher
   (badge), ALL threads visible, chats charge workspace keys (owner) unless
   invitee's "use my own keys" toggle → own keys.
8. **thread share** → owner toggles share, guest accepts → SAME live thread in
   guest's INVITES group + header badge, guest chats with OWN keys + name on
   bubbles, cannot edit plan/rename; owner revoke removes access instantly.
9. **deleted thread** → soft-archive 30 days (trash), recover → live;
   after 30 days hard-delete (incl. runs/activities/files).
10. **"re-run last run"** → play a rerun (trigger=rerun) with same plan, no
    new chat; hits new `runs` row, streams activities again.
11. **first message** → auto-titles thread; title editable after.

## L. Non-goals / pinned decisions
- Markdown rendering: FUTURE (write API to be parser-friendly — parts, no
  prose-heavy gating). Output contract ready for it.
- Media generation: IMAGE + TRANSCRIPTION SHIPPED in MVP (lazy-load provider
  when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` configured); SPEECH/VIDEO stay schemas
  only until models exist. Attachments always converted to LLM-readable parts.
- Sub-agents in parallel: FUTURE phase (see FEATURES.md); design tool outputs as
  containers so sub-agent results merge into `run_activities`.
- Creating MULTIPLE owned workspaces: FUTURE (pro tier). MVP = 1 owned
  Personal + unlimited JOINED workspaces (via invite).
- Shared-thread plan editing by guests: OFF (owner/editor only).

## Product features (locked in docs; see NOTES "Decisions" & PLAN.md)
1. **Soft-archive delete**: deleting a thread/workflow sets `threads.deleted_at`;
   recoverable 30 days (trash), then hard-delete incl. Storage. Never silent.
2. **Smart auto-title**: thread title automatically set from the first user
   message (truncated); rename still available. No blank "New thread".
3. **One Run mental model**: Run button AND the LLM both fire `thread/run`
   (same event). WorkflowApproval dialog = max 4 buttons: Approve+Run /
   Approve / Decline / Edit plan. No dead dropdowns.
4. **Model presets**: Agent/Env tab shows a per-provider list of known model
   ids (searchable) + free-text override; picks write `workspace_api_keys.model_name`.
5. **Share preview page**: share link lands on a preview (thread title + owner
   name only, NO content) with Accept — content stays private until accepted.
6. **Export/import thread**: single JSON (plan + steps + key messages,
   keys stripped) for export/import — template/reuse path.
7. **Re-run**: from a past Run play a rerun with the same plan, no new chat
   (`runs.rerun_of`, trigger=rerun).

Audited: monorepo at `D:\github-desktop\aevryn` (read-only).
Scope: whole repo described in `AGENTS.md`, `internal/` decisions/plans, all
`NEWTODO` markers, and the live data paths they depend on.

---

## 1. What the system is today

A persistent web-agent platform. The legacy flow:

```
Next.js UI (hardcoded demo)
→ tRPC router  packages/api/src/routers/agent.ts  (630 lines)
→ WorkflowService  packages/workflow/src/services/workflow-service.ts  (1517 lines)
→ 13 repositories → Drizzle → PostgreSQL
   +  Inngest functions:
       execution-run.ts (914 lines)   — the whole agent loop
       schedule-tick.ts  (143 lines)  — cron + sleep/wake
       notification-notifier.ts       — webhook delivery
```

Capabilities (`packages/agent`): 13 registered capabilities wrapping 6 Anakin
adapters (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire) + browser sessions + memory +
schedules. Approval-gated: `wireAction`, `browserSessionCreate/Rename/Delete`.

LLM (Groq via Vercel AI SDK `ai` v7): `runAgent` in
`packages/agent/src/runtime.ts` drives a single `generateText` loop with
`isStepCount(maxSteps)` and the SDK's `toolApproval` gate. Plans and runtime
decisions are extracted from the model's final text with `/\`\`\`json...\`\`\`/`
regex in `packages/inngest/src/functions/execution-run.ts:48`.

Re-architecture already decided in `internal/plans/2026-09-10-aevryn-rearchitecture/`
and `internal/ALL-DECISIONS.md`:
thread === workflow, first message ≠ objective, planning output =
`AskUserQuestion[]` (MCQ), chat streams in the web app via `POST /api/chat`
(`useChat` + zod tools `askUserQuestion` / `showPlan` / `finalizeAndInject`),
ONE Inngest `execution/run` event only on plan approval, Supabase Auth,
mem0 per-thread memory. `apps/web/src/app/workspace/[threadId]/page.tsx` is the
empty stub that must become this.

---

## 2. NEWTODO inventory (the user's own work order)

| # | File:line | Ask |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/auth/README.md:1` | Rebuild auth — Supabase Google signup ONLY |
| 2 | `packages/api/README.md:1` | Rebuild API ("only when 100% sure") |
| 3 | `packages/agent/src/README.md:1` | Fix `runtime.ts` hardcoded prompts → real prompt library module |
| 4 | `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1,3` | Decide how adapter schemas reach the LLM (tool call vs global memory); note: schemas already live in capabilities via `inputSchema` |
| 5 | `packages/agent/src/adapters/scrape.ts:1` | Verify exact `@anakin-io/sdk` `ScrapeFormat` list (current union may be wrong) |
| 6 | `packages/workflow/README.md:1` | Rebuild `workflow` package after new plan |
| 7 | `packages/db/src/schema/README.md:1,3` | Migrate current schema first, then design a brand-new schema |
| 8 | `packages/inngest/src/README.md:1,3` | Inngest only for thread-bound workflow event + cron; rebuild `/inngest` (functions dir too big) |
| 9 | `packages/ui/src/components/ui/ask-user-questions.tsx:37` | `AskUserQuestion` interface WILL be the schema the LLM gets via tool call |
| 10 | `packages/ui/src/components/header/searchable-dropdown.tsx:16,41` | Real workflows/groups from DB; unify the header input bar into one place |
| 11 | `packages/ui/src/components/sidebar-preset/nav-data.ts:18` | Real data from DB |
| 12 | `apps/web/src/app/workspace/page.tsx:253` | Run button visible only after workflow planned + approved + bound |
| 13 | `apps/web/src/app/workspace/page.tsx:338` | `mb-40` spacing → new component or inline utility |

---

## 3. Confirmed breakages (behind "cron not working", "AI SDK not working")

1. **`schedule-tick` has no trigger and is never served.**
   `packages/inngest/src/functions/schedule-tick.ts:21-25` declares
   `inngest.createFunction({ id: "schedule-tick", retries: 2 }, ...)` with no
   `triggers` array, and `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts:9` registers
   ONLY `executionRun`. Result: cron jobs, sleep→wake, and due-work sweeping
   can never fire. This is the root cause of "cron broken".

2. **`notificationNotifier` is also never served.** `notification/publish`
   events (`execution-run.ts:763`) are dropped at the SDK boundary → webhook
   notifications and anywhere-outside-the-app delivery are dead.

3. **`resumeWorkflow` does nothing useful.**
   `workflow-service.ts:1024` flips `paused → active` but never enqueues a new
   execution or sends `execution/run`. A "resumed" workflow sits idle forever.

4. **Orphaned executions on event-send failure.** Every mutator in
   `agent.ts` (`sendMessage`, `confirmWorkflow`, `updateObjective`,
   `runWorkflow`, `resolveApproval`) follows
   `enqueueMessage() → inngest.send()` and on send error calls
   `failExecution()`, but the row created by `enqueueMessage` stays
   `pending`. If `inngest.send` throws after enqueue, nothing ever processes
   that execution → permanent orphan. This send+fail block is copy-pasted 5×
   and is the prime candidate to kill when `/api/chat` takes over.

5. **Decision parsing is regex over free-text.** `extractPlan`/`extractDecision`
   (`execution-run.ts:48`) parse a fenced ```json block out of the model's
   final message. Fragile by design and contradicts AGENTS.md rule 8/9/10
   (structured schemas, no free-text control). The re-architecture replaces it
   with real SDK tool calls. Same for `planning.ts:21` (JSON-in-prose).

6. **Cost budget is post-hoc, not bound.** `runAgentStep` checks
   `result.usage.costUsd > EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD` AFTER the whole run completes
   (`execution-run.ts:594`). It can never stop a run from overspending, it only
   schedules a recovery afterwards.

7. **`replayedToolOutputs` is keyed by tool name** (`runtime.ts:160`) and
   consumed once. Fine for the single-retry case, but two capabilities with the
   same name would collide; also replay happens before the response cap, so a
   huge persisted output can refill context.

8. **`GROQ_MODEL` default is `openai/gpt-oss-20b`** (`packages/env/src/server.ts:35`).
   Verify this exact model id exists on Groq — if the dev was running a local
   override this default may 404 in production. `MEM0_API_KEY` defaults to `""`
   (silent no-op backend).

9. **`resumeWorkflow` + pause semantics.** `pauseWorkflow` cancels live
   executions (`workflow-service.ts:985`) and flips workflow to "paused";
   schedules are NOT disabled on pause (they just no-op while paused). See #3.

10. **No `/api/chat`, no realtime.** The workspace renders a fully hardcoded
    conversation (`workspace/page.tsx`, 567 lines: mock `questions`,
    `workflowApproval`, accordion plan, tool-step cards, table). `trpc` client
    exists (`apps/web/src/utils/trpc.ts`) but nothing in workspace calls it.
    `[threadId]/page.tsx` is 8 lines of stub.

---

## 4. Architecture / data-model observations

- **`WorkflowService` is a 66-public-method god class** spanning every domain
  concept (workflow, execution, steps, state, schedule, approval, notification,
  observation, recovery, webhook, usage). The `internal/02-BACKEND-AUDIT.md`
  split is still correct; do not rebuild the same shape.
- **Bad JSONB typing:** `notification.body` and `recoveryAttempt.detail` are
  `$type<z.input<typeof eventDataSchema>>` (`notification.ts:29`,
  `recovery-attempt.ts:36`) — a domain model forced onto the event data schema.
  Harmless at runtime, misleading to readers, and the new schema should drop it.
- **IDs:** domain tables use `text("id")` PKs and `@aevryn/db` `ids.*` /
  `isValidId`. Verify every new table gets a prefixed ULID and that
  `ID_PREFIXES` in `packages/db/src/ids.ts` stays in sync with the AGENTS.md
  prefix list (wf_/exe_/step_/tool_/mem_/evt_/rec_).
- **Auth tables keep OAuth tokens in plaintext** (`account.access_token`/`refresh_token`,
  `auth.ts:52-53`). Standard better-auth shape, but silently conflicts with
  "never store secrets" — will be deleted anyway by the Supabase Auth rebuild.
- **Memory:** only `Mem0MemoryStore` implements `MemoryStore`
  (`memory/mem0-store.ts`). It degrades silently without a key. AGENTS.md and
  `internal/08` target PostgreSQL + pgvector with a deliberate write policy;
  mem0 is hosted and per `userId`, which also fights the "adapter schemas as
  GLOBAL memory" idea in `adapters/README.md:1` (mem0 scopes by user, so a
  schema memory would not be global). Decide and document; current state is
  both.
- **Good parts worth keeping:** optimistic-concurrency `applyState` (version
  checks), `webhookBoard` token hashing, idempotent `resolveExecutionState`
  gate, bounded recovery with `recordRecoveryAttempt` returning a boolean so
  concurrent failure handlers cannot double-schedule, `replayedToolOutputs`
  honoring the "never re-run a possibly-succeeded side effect" rule, Evlog
  instrumentation + request-id plumbing (`proxy.ts`, `evlog.ts`), and the
  `ask-user-questions.tsx` component itself (the exact UX the new tool schema
  must feed).
- **UI stack is ready** but unwired: `QueryClientProvider` is active
  (`providers.tsx:41`), zustand is installed with zero stores, and every data
  surface (sidebar nav, dropdown, workspace) is mocked.

---

## 5. Suggested work order (aligned with the user's NEWTODOs)

1. Fix triggers/services first: give `schedule-tick` a real cron trigger (or
   move cron to a DB-driven sweeper invoked by Inngest `cron`), and register
   `notificationNotifier` in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts`.
2. Supabase Auth rebuild (`packages/auth`) — GIANT prerequisite for every
   `ctx.session` and the whole UI.
3. Schema: run `db:generate`/`db:migrate` NOW to snapshot the current schema
   (NEWTODO #7) before redesigning tables for the new thread/chat model.
4. `/api/chat` route + `useChat` + zod tools (`askUserQuestion`, `showPlan`,
   `finalizeAndInject`); derive the `AskUserQuestion` zod schema directly from
   the component interface (`ask-user-questions.tsx:38`).
5. Inngest shrink to exactly: thread-bound `execution/run` (send only on
   approval) + cron; delete the regex plan/decision extraction and the 5×
   duplicated send/fail blocks.
6. Wire UI: `searchable-dropdown`, `nav-data`, workspace page, per-thread
   routing, realtime via chat streaming; keep `run` button gated on bound/
   approved state (NEWTODO #12).
7. Sweep the ScrapeFormat union against the installed `@anakin-io/sdk`
   (`scrape.ts:1`) and set `GROQ_MODEL` to a confirmed live model id.

All findings are verifiable by reading the cited files; none of this is a code
change — this file documents the state as of the audit.

# ENV — Variables & User-Suppliable Keys

Three layers: **server/infra env** (Vercel/Next server, never client),
**user workspace keys** (entered by user in Workflow Settings → Agent/Env tab,
stored in DB, encrypted), and **per-thread overrides** (rare, optional).

## Existing env (old backend → what to keep)

| Var | Used by (old) | New use |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` / `DIRECT_URL` | drizzle pg | → Supabase project connection string (keep, used by drizzle) |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` / `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | better-auth | **DELETE** (Supabase Auth owns sessions) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | unused today | keep — supabase-js client |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | unused today | keep — anon role for RLS/DATA API |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | — | **ADD** server-only, storage uploads + admin (never NEXT_PUBLIC) |
| `ANAKIN_API_KEY` / `ANAKIN_BASE_URL` | agent adapters | fallback default; user can override per workspace |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` / `GROQ_MODEL` | runtime | fallback defaults; per workspace override |
| `MEM0_API_KEY` | workflow mem0 | fallback; per workspace override |
| `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` / `SIGNING_KEY` / `APP_ID` | inngest client | keep |
| `WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` | webhook-board | keep |
| `AGENT_MAX_STEPS` / `AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS` / `EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS` / `EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD` / `EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS` / `RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | inngest | keep as server caps (hard ceiling) |

## NEW env (definitive list, final)

```
# --- Supabase ---
DATABASE_URL                # postgres connection for drizzle (direct)
DIRECT_URL                  # pooler direct url (non-pooled, for migrations)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL    # client
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY  # client anon (never secret)
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY   # server only — storage bucket mgmt, user creation
SUPABASE_AUTH_SECRET        # optional: for verifying webhook JWT from auth hooks

# --- Inngest ---
INNGEST_EVENT_KEY
INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY
INNGEST_APP_ID

# --- Webhook interop ---
WEBHOOK_BASE_URL            # base url for generated /api/v1/hooks/:token urls

# --- Defaults (single fallback key each; user overrides per-workspace in UI) ---
ANAKIN_API_KEY
ANAKIN_BASE_URL             # default https://api.anakin.io/v1
GROQ_API_KEY
GROQ_MODEL                  # default text model, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-20b
MEM0_API_KEY

# --- Server hard caps (clamp user values; not editable by user) ---
AGENT_MAX_STEPS             # default 5      — ceiling
AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS        # default 50     — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS       # default 900    — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD      # default 1      — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS # default 604800 — ceiling
RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS       # default 2      — ceiling

# --- Model routing (per category; fall back from workspace → env default) ---
TEXT_MODEL                   # alias of GROQ_MODEL default (kept by name parity)
IMAGE_MODEL                  # default e.g. groq/text2img or provider, optional
SPEECH_MODEL                 # optional
TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL          # optional
VIDEO_MODEL                  # optional (future)
```

> Client (`packages/env/src/web.ts`) must expose only:
> `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
> Everything else stays server-only. `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION` respected.

## Where the USER enters their own keys (UI)

Primary → **Workflow Settings dialog → "Agent" tab** (rename of
"Instructions"), with an **"Environment"** subsection:

- Groq API key + Groq model (text)
- Anakin API key + base URL
- Mem0 API key
- (secondary) Image / Speech / Transcription / Video model overrides

Stored in DB table `workspace_api_keys`:
`workspace_id | user_id | provider | key_name | key_value(encrypted) | created_at`.

Resolution order at call time:
```
1. member of a SHARED workspace + user_profiles.prefer_own_keys_in_shared=true
     → member's OWN Personal workspace keys
2. workspace keys (the workspace the thread belongs to)
3. env default
```
`workflow_api_keys` optional per-thread override keyed same way (rare).
Encryption: AES-256-GCM with `APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` env (add to server env) — or
Supabase Vault (`vault.create_secret`) if service_role available. Recommend
**Supabase Vault** — no extra env key, native audit.

> Note: ChatComposer token slider = "max tokens per chat request" — maps to
> `streamText.maxOutputTokens`, NOT a run budget. Server caps
> (`AGENT_MAX_STEPS` etc.) remain hard ceilings.

## Best placement reasoning
- Workspace is the right scope: keys belong to a workspace, reusable in the
  `PERSONAL` workspace and future ones. Thread-level is pointless UX (user
  shouldn't re-enter per thread); we allow per-thread override but never require.
- Server retains hard caps so a user cannot self-grant unlimited budgets.
- Never ship keys to client — tools run server-side (Inngest/route), so only
  server reads them.

# FEATURES — Beyond the MVP (better capabilities & tools)

Ideas to make the tool stronger. Keep "LLM decides, nothing hardcoded".

## Tool-call improvements

### 1. `httpRequest` (user-bearer arbitrary HTTP)
- Schema: `{method, url, headers?{name,value}[], body?, timeoutMs≤30000,
  auth?:{type:"bearer", token}}`, response `{status, headers, bodyText, bodyJson?}`.
- Safety: SSRF firewall (block private IPs/localhost/metadata), size cap,
  max redirects 3, no follow to non-http. Used when SDK lacks an action.

### 2. Anakin SDK expansion (currently underused — see NOTES/Anakin)
- `sessions.save` → interactive-login flow (createSession → noVNC → user logs in
  → save → authenticate scrapes). Map to `browserSessionSave` capability
  (approval required).
- Screenshots: add `screenshot`/`screenshotFullPage` to scrape formats;
  pipeline downloads PNG server-side (SDK doesn't) → Supabase Storage →
  image part in chat (ThinkingStepImage supports src).
- `forceFresh`, `countries`/`SUPPORTED_COUNTRY_CODES` validation,
  `generateJson`/`outputSchema`, polling knobs.
- Batch scrape (≤10 URLs), inline scrape, `ai-visibility` (fan to 3 engines),
  monitors CRUD, wire catalog/identities/vaults (`wire-run`), Wire file
  downloads (`GET /wire/jobs/:id/download`) — all REST-only, expose via
  capabilities that call raw HTTP (this is where **httpRequest tool** shines:
  LLM can call official REST endpoints not yet wrapped).

### 3. Tool approval replay (existing → keep) + auto-approve system msg
- Keep `replayedToolOutputs` (don't re-run possibly-succeeded writes).
- Auto-approve: workflow.auto_approve → auto-resolve approval + system message
  "auto-approved via settings".

### 4. `listCapabilities` / schema-as-memory
- Resolve adapters/README.md:1: expose capability schemas via GLOBAL memory
  searched by LLM before delegating; keep a static `capabilityCatalog` tool as
  fallback (cheap, in chat). Nothing hardcoded in prompt.

### 5. Media generation (per user request) — NOW IN MVP
- IMAGE + TRANSCRIPTION: shipped when model configured in workflow Agent/Env tab
  (`IMAGE_MODEL` / `TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL`). `generateImage({kind:"image",prompt,...})`
  → response image uploaded to Storage → message part. `transcribeAudio` uses
  VAD + provider. Attachments in ChatComposer/ChatMessage: image/pdf/video →
  converted to LLM-readable content parts (data-URL image, extracted text for
  pdf) BEFORE the live API call. SPEECH/VIDEO: schema stubs only (future).

## Architecture extras

### 6. Sub-agent container (FUTURE, "agent assigns sub agents")
- Noted in instructions. Design: durable runner can spawn parallel
  `run_activities` children; each sub-agent returns `{role, findings}` to a
  container activity; main LLM reads container. No DB change — already
  `run_activities.parent_id`.

### 7. Durable queued messages (durability fix)
- User asked for an answer: implement queue rows in DB (`status='queued'`,
  `queue_order`), re-pulled on page load. Auto-fire when current run finishes
  (realtime event). Even plain text survives close — since chat persists.

### 8. Per-workspace keys + Vault + member key override
- `workspace_api_keys` (Vault/AES) so each future workspace can BYO keys.
  Env fallback → workspace → (member's own Personal keys when
  `prefer_own_keys_in_shared=true` and user is a member of the shared
  workspace) — resolution order in ARCHITECTURE §I.

### 9. Realtime notifications (with unread chip)
- Notifications dialog + number chip on thread button (user: "add number chip").
  Realtime broadcast on insert. Mark-all-read on dialog open.

### 10. Image compression pipeline
- Browser canvas: re-encode to WebP, quality ~0.8, max 2000px, keep EXIF?
  no — strip. Then `files` insert + Storage. Same pipeline reused for model
  screenshots.

### 11. Parser-friendly output contract
- All tool outputs structured (`{type, data}`) for future markdown/table
  renderers. Table component exists — return `table` parts when tabular.

### 12. Invites (workspace + thread) + parallel group run — IN MVP
- Workspace invite: owner shares link → invitee becomes member of owner's REAL
  workspace (owner/editor/viewer), all threads visible, keys = workspace
  unless member override toggle; owner only manages members.
- Thread share: owner toggles `share_enabled` → invitee sees the SAME live
  thread under their sidebar INVITES group (Badge on thread + header); uses
  own keys; owner can revoke.
- Group run-all / stop-all runs PARALLEL (≤5 workflows per group).

## UX polish ideas (fold into UI.md)
- Queue: token-quality slider → maxTokens per chat request; bugfix (pointer-
  events) — decouple slider.
- ChatComposer centered→bottom transition on first message.
- Run/Stop button gated on bound workflow; per-item run/stop in sidebar menu.
- Notifications chip; theme toggle; profile dialog (incl. "use my own keys in
  invited workspaces" toggle); settings = Workspace group (General+Members)
  vs Global group (Notifications/Appearance/Security).
- INVITES system group (locked, real) + Badge components (thread button right-side
  beside count number; thread header; workspace switcher).

# NOTES — Facts Archive (caveman)

Engineered notes. Facts from repo audit + docs. Written during exploration to
survive compaction. Code refs `path:line`.

## Stack (live)
- Bun 1.3.9, Turborepo, TS ~6.0, React ^19.2, Next ^16.3, `ai` ^7.0.93
  (`streamText`, `Chat`, `ToolLoopAgent`, `toolApproval`, `stopWhen`),
  `@ai-sdk/react` ^4.0.100 (`useChat`, `DefaultChatTransport`),
  `@ai-sdk/groq` ^4.0.37, tRPC v11, drizzle ^0.45, better-auth 1.7.1,
  inngest ^4.20, mem0ai, zustand (0 stores yet), zod ^4.5.
- Supabase local CLI scaffold exists: `packages/db/supabase/config.toml`,
  `.temp/cli-latest`=v2.117.0, `schema_paths=[]`, migrations enabled,
  `seed/seed.sql` referenced but MISSING. Auth enabled (external google
  defaults off). Storage enabled. `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` +
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `apps/web/.env` but UNUSED.
- Harness: pg (node-postgres) via DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL. better-auth tables:
  user/session/account/verification. `src/migrations/` has only `.gitkeep` —
  NO real migrations yet.

## Backend pieces (to be replaced)
- `@aevryn/api` tRPC: `agentRouter` muts = sendMessage, confirmWorkflow,
  discardPlan, updateObjective, runWorkflow, stopWorkflow, toggleSchedule,
  deleteSchedule, markNotificationsRead, resolveApproval, deleteMemories,
  deleteAllMemories, pauseWorkflow, resumeWorkflow. Queries = getThread,
  unreadNotifications, listRuns, listNotifications, listApprovals, listMemories.
- `@aevryn/workflow` WorkflowService god class (1517 lines, ~66 methods), 12
  repos, `schemas.ts` (planSchema `{title,objective,summary,steps}`,
  decisionSchema `{action: complete|sleep|notify|stop|wait,...}`),
  Mem0 store null-degrades w/o key.
- `@aevryn/inngest`: functions execution-run (914 lines, idempotent gate,
  regex-extracts ```json plan/decision), notification-notifier, schedule-tick
  (NO trigger — cron dead), served at `/api/inngest` ONLY executionRun.
- `@aevryn/agent`: 13 capabilities (searchWeb, scrapeUrl, crawlSite, mapSite,
  researchTopic, wireAction, browserSessionList/Create/Rename/Delete,
  createSchedule, storeMemory, searchMemory). Registry + runtime
  `generateText` loop w/ toolApproval gate, replay-by-tool-name, inline
  TOOL_SELECTION_INSTRUCTIONS.
- Env server: DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_URL,
  ANAKIN_API_KEY/BASE_URL, INNGEST_EVENT_KEY/SIGNING_KEY/APP_ID,
  GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_MODEL (default `openai/gpt-oss-20b`), MEM0_API_KEY,
  AGENT_MAX_STEPS=5, AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS=50, EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS=900,
  EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD=1, EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS=604800,
  RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=2, WEBHOOK_BASE_URL. web.ts client empty.

## Anakin SDK 0.1.0 (full surface)
- Client: scrape, map, crawl, search, agenticSearch, wire, countries,
  sessions.{list,create,save,update,delete}.
- ScrapeFormat: markdown|html|cleanedHtml|json|links|images|screenshot|
  screenshotFullPage|summary. Document{...screenshotUrl,fullPageScreenshotUrl}.
- Raw PNG download NOT wrapped — need authed GET /v1/url-scraper/{id}/screenshot.
- Unused today: sessions.save (login→save loop), screenshots, json/links/
  images/summary formats, forceFresh, countries/SUPPORTED_COUNTRY_CODES,
  generateJson, polling knobs.
- REST-only (NOT in SDK): batch scrape ≤10 urls, inline scrape, outputSchema
  on scrape, monitors CRUD, ai-visibility, per-request webhook_url + HMAC
  signature, wire catalog/identities/vaults/wire-run(file downloads),
  CDP Browser API (wss browser-connect: click/type/press/mouse/drag/scroll/
  tabs/waits/evaluate/route/intercept + `?save_session=` `?session_id=`).
- Node-only SDK (no browser build). Adapters call only basic methods.

## UI (packages/ui + apps/web)
- ChatComposer: no props, self-contained. value, files[], queue[], status(idle/
  streaming demo), quality slider 0..50000 (labels Free→God), QueuedStack
  drag-reorder/edit/remove, suggestions[4], openFilePicker, accept default
  image/png,image/jpeg,application/pdf. has onQueueChange/onStop.
- ChatMessage props: `{from:"user"|"assistant", files?:File[],
  thumbnailSize=64, time?, actions?, size?}`. NO `attachment` prop — files only;
  FileThumbnail renders. (User hoped for video/image attachment − need to add).
- SystemMessage: `{icon?,isIconHidden?,cta?:{label,onClick,variant}, cva
  variant: action|error|warning, fill?:bool}`.
- ask-user-questions: AskUserQuestion{id,title,options?,multiSelect?,
  allowOther?,otherPlaceholder?,skippable?,nextLabel?,layout:inline|stacked,
  chipPosition:left|right, freeText?,freeTextPlaceholder?,freeTextMultiline?,
  freeTextValidate?}; AskUserOption{id?,title,description?};
  AskUserAnswer{questionId,selectedIds[],otherText?,skipped?}. NEWTODO:37
  says becomes LLM toolcall schema. QuestionFlow wrapper in packages/ui.
- ThinkingSteps: ThinkingStep{icon(IconName),showIcon,label,description?,
  status:complete|active|pending,delay,isLast}, ThinkingStepDetails{summary,
  details:string[]}, ThinkingStepSources/Source{color,...}, ThinkingStepImage
  {src,alt,caption}. ThinkingIndicator animated morph+words.
- tool-step-calls.tsx: mock ResearchAgent/WebScrapeAgent/CompilingAgent/
  FinalAnswerStep — hardcoded ThinkingSteps.
- workspace/page.tsx (567): ALL hardcoded. Header = SearchableDropdown +
  InputGroup rename (no-op) + Run btn + Settings btn (NEWTODO:253 run visible
  after bound workflow). Conversation = mock ChatMessage/QuestionFlow/
  AccordionGroup(items)/Table/SystemMessage(actions)/ThinkingIndicator.
  Footer ChatComposer empty. NEWTODO:338 mb-40.
- Sidebar (packages/ui/app-sidebar.tsx 419, src-slot empty in web):
  workspace switch (Acme Inc/Personal/New), search (Cmd+K), notifications
  btn (Cmd+N, no chip yet), new btn (Cmd+O), NAV_SECTIONS groups w/ add +
  section dropdown (run all/stop all/rename/delete all), items w/ status dot +
  badge, hover run/stop + rename + 3-dot(share/delete), footer settings/
  theme/user row (Jane Doe mock, Profile no-op). nav-data.ts hardcoded.
- searchable-dropdown: hardcoded WORKFLOW_GROUPS. NEWTODO:16,41.
- workflow-dialog (546): SECTIONS general{name, desc, autoApprove switch, delete},
  share{InputCopy mock}, plan{steps editable}, instructions{system prompt only},
  memories{mock}. NEWTODO wants "Agent" tab + env tab for user keys.
- settings-dialog (491): General/Notifications/Appearance/Security/Members.
- notifications-dialog (119): mock 5 {id,content,read}, no mark-all-read.
- No ProfileDialog (menu no-op). No Toaster mounted. providers = Theme,
  SizeContext, QueryClient(+devtools). authClient dead code.
- Notifications unread-chip missing (user: add like thread button).

## User's new rules
- Auth: Google Supabase ONLY for MVP. Pre-signup questions (who are you: student/
  engineer/AI engineer/...) → profile. Root page.tsx = login screen.
- Workspace "PERSONAL" auto-created per user. MVP single workspace. Schema scalable.
- Sidebar: section search by thread title, notifications chip + mark-read-on-open,
  New btn → new workflow GROUP, group dropdown run all/stop all/rename/delete all,
  workflow item name + status icon + hover run/stop/rename/3-dot.
- Header: dropdown (workflows) + inline rename input. Run/Stop btn only if
  workflow BOUND by toolcall. Workflow settings btn.
- Chat: useChat direct; LLM tools (zod+schema+desc); Anakin tool calls → Inngest
  durable; Inngest returns schematic JSON → ThinkingSteps realtime (sub-tasks too,
  e.g. "reading portfolio/about.html/projects.html"). SystemMessage on error/
  warning/retry; new ChatMessage(assistant) only when error/warning/workflow
  stops/restarts — append same message when running. QuestionFlow parent for
  questionflow, workflowbindingapproval, event approval. Plan editable anyplace.
  LLM decides plan yes/no/steps; user approval UI = workflowApproval questions
  (approve/decline/bind-not-run/request-changes). Decline destroys plan.
  Auto-approve switch → auto Approve + system msg "auto approved via settings".
- Queued messages durable (close window safe). ChatComposer center → bottom after
  first msg; route swap `workspace/<threadId>` no reload. Media: image/pdf upload,
  compress image w/o quality loss → supabase storage. Markdown later (table comp
  ready). Mediums: text, image, speech, transcription, video (per model settings).
- sub-agents parallel later (container collects). mem0 per-thread + global tool.
  zustand for client state; keep server components.
- DB: migrate OLD schema → migration file (snapshot) FIRST, then write NEW schema
  w/ FKs + best practices. No docstrings in code. No hardcoding.
- Deliverables: questions.md, features.md, UI file, PROMPTS file (all prompts in
  one place, export/import), final-docs organizing everything. Env analysis.

## Decisions (locked answers, 2026 round 2)
- Roles ONE set everywhere: **owner | editor | viewer** (admin DROPPED).
  Workspace: owner full (settings/keys/members), editor works (create/edit/run/
  delete ANY thread+group, edit plans), viewer read-only. Thread: owner =
  threads.user_id; guests via thread_shares role editor|viewer.
- **Workspace invite** = join the owner's REAL workspace (no copy): accept →
  workspace_members row; all threads visible to all members; member mgmt owner
  only; editor can delete ANY thread; viewers read-only.
- **Keys in shared workspace**: workspace keys (owner pays) by default;
  profile toggle `prefer_own_keys_in_shared` → member's OWN Personal keys.
  Resolution: member-override → workspace → env.
- **Thread share** = live SAME thread (not fork): guest sees it in their own
  sidebar under the **INVITES system group** (created locked+empty at signup,
  fills only via accepted invites) + Badge (thread button right, beside
  count number; also on header). Guest uses OWN keys; sends msgs with their
  name; CANNOT rename/edit plan/bind/re-share/delete. Owner revoke instant.
  Owner toggles per-thread `threads.share_enabled` (switch list UI).
- Onboarding questions: JSON config (user edits), multi+single select, stored
  pre_answers jsonb; auto-navigate to onboarding if profile missing.
- NO auto-plan: LLM never showPlan/bind alone; only on explicit user ask.
  2nd msg ≠ plan. Bind → Run shows/Stop hidden; Run toggles→Stop while running.
- Token `quality` slider = max tokens PER CHAT request (maxOutputTokens), NOT
  run budget.
- ≤5 threads per group, ≤3 groups per workspace (free) — enforced at insert;
  group run-all/stop-all runs PARALLEL.
- Queue: durable DB rows; drain SEQUENTIAL (deliver → wait finish → next);
  editable/reordered rows persist order+content.
- Media: image + transcription SHIPPED (lazy if IMAGE_MODEL/TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL
  set); speech/video stubs; attachments → LLM-readable parts (img data-url,
  pdf text).
- Memory: ONE mem0 store per user; thread mem = metadata.threadId; global =
  program-given facts injected beforehand, works in ALL workspaces/everywhere.
- HTTP request tool: safe default (https-only, private-IP blocked, size caps,
  max redirects, bearer opt-in from user field).
- SDK-compatible names KEPT (askQuestion, showPlan, editPlan,
  finalizeAndInject/bindWorkflow, storeMemory/searchMemory, httpRequest,
  delegateAgenticWork, listCapabilities, generateImage, transcribeAudio).
- Delete account = hard delete everything incl. Storage. Workflows/threads
  delete = cascade all (no history).
- Pricing = plan limits (free: 5 threads/group, 3 groups/workspace, 1 owned
  workspace; pro: more). runs.cost_usd + token_count recorded always.
- Inngest cron for schedule-tick (registered + served). Markdown renderer
  deferred; output contract parser-friendly. Attachment extension: ChatMessage
  { files[], images[], video[], audio[] }.
- Groq "name differs per account": model ids are just strings; accounts have
  different available/ejected models. Ship per-provider MODEL PRESETS
  (searchable) in Agent/Env tab + free-text override.
- INVITES = REAL system group, created empty+locked at signup (PERSONAL/SITE/
  WORKFLOWS/INVITES); user cannot add/rename/delete; fills ONLY via accepted
  thread invites (thread appears there w/ badge).
- Product features (locked): soft-archive delete (deleted_at, recover 30d,
  then purge); smart auto-title from first msg; one Run model (Run btn + LLM
  both fire thread/run; approval dialog 4 buttons max: Approve+Run/Approve/
  Decline/Edit plan); model presets; share preview page (title+owner only, no
  content pre-accept); export/import thread JSON (keys stripped); re-run last
  run (runs.rerun_of, trigger=rerun, same plan, no chat).

supposed to kill.

approval, event, execution, notification, observation, recovery, schedule,
state, step, tool-execution, webhook, workflow. One file = one table, raw

`workflow`, `workflow_execution`, `workflow_step`, `tool_execution`,

  plan accepted.

- Respect auto-approve: if enabled, resolve approval automatically and say
  "auto-approved via settings" as system message.
- Media: `generateImage`/`transcribeAudio` available only when their model is
  configured for this workspace.

## 3. `PLANNING_SYSTEM` (works with showPlan/askQuestion flow)
"Given the objective, plan scope: ask clarifying questions first when needed.
When you're ready, build the plan. Each step must be actionable and
factored < 20 lines of description. Order critical steps first."

(approve / decline / bind / approve-and-run). Do NOT begin actions before
approval. If declined, discard plan and ask what changed."

"You are executing plan step N/total. Only the tools you have may run.

silently stop."

## Required NEW components (missing today)

- Login screen (Google button) → redirect to `/workspace/[threadId]` or
  `/workspace`.
- Onboarding: pre-questions wizard driven by a JSON config file/DB-row (user
  edits JSON, app maps to QuestionFlow). Multi-select + single-select both
  supported. Save → `user_profiles.pre_answers` → go to workspace. If signup

- No signup email — Google only MVP.
- Badge component (packages/ui): used on INVITES group badge, workspace
  switcher button badge (joined workspaces), thread header badge.

### 2. Profile dialog (missing; menu item currently no-op)
- Sidebar-layout dialog (same frame as settings/workflow dialog).
- Contents: avatar+pfp, name/email, pre_answers display, plan badge,
  **"use my own keys in invited workspaces" toggle**, delete account (danger),
  sign out.

  all read on open (server realtime latest-insert ordering).

- Current props only accept `files?: File[]`. Extend:
  `files`, `images[]`, `video[]`, `audio[]`, `attachmentData`.
  ImageComponent fallback: if file type image → thumbnail; else FileThumbnail.
  PDF stays File chip. Video/audio → inline players for media tools.
- Attachments drop into ChatComposer get converted to LLM-readable parts
  (image → data URL / base64; pdf → extracted text) before the API call.

### 5. Workflow-dialog → split tab (rename per user)
- Rename sidebar `Instructions` → **Agent**.
- Add tab **Environment** (inside Agent or General panel): Groq/Anakin/Mem0
  keys + model name inputs (write `workspace_api_keys`).
- **Share tab real data**: thread share toggle (`threads.share_enabled`),
  per-thread InputCopy link + guests list w/ role Select + revoke button.

  workspace-level member section OR workflow dialog share — put as

- Delete-workflow confirm: single dialog accepting id or name, showing name +
  item count + text of what's being deleted (WorkflowDelConfirmationDialog
  exists — wire real data). Soft-delete → Trash (recoverable 30 days).

### 6. Settings dialog restructure (two sidebar groups)
- **Workspace** group (tabs):
  - *General* (only workspace name — the rename field currently in General).
  - *Members*: InputCopy workspace invite link + list of accepted members with
    role Select (`owner`/`editor`/`viewer`) + `Remove` button per row
    (SettingRow pattern from decisions). Owner row locked (can't remove self).
- **Global** group (tabs):
  - Notifications, Appearance, Security (+ any leftover general fields).
- Remove old monolithic General tab fields to the correct subtabs.

### 7. Sidebar real data + INVITES group + badges
- `nav-data.ts` `NAV_SECTIONS` ← DB: workspace groups (threads/titles/statuses).

# PLAN — Full Implementation Plan

Milestone-driven, each phase independently verifiable. Build order respects
dependency: DB first, services next, Inngest, then UI, then polish.

## P0 — Groundwork & migrations (prereq for everything)
- [ ] Supabase local running; `supabase init` config sanity (`config.toml`
      `schema_paths`, real migrate workflow). Create `001_old_schema_snapshot`
      via drizzle-kit (see `db/MIGRATION.md`).
- [ ] `supabase/migrations` seed enforcement (drop seed file, use trigger).
- [ ] `scripts/` service helpers updated (no destructive ops in CI).
- [ ] Verify `bun run db:generate` produces snapshot; commit as baseline.
- **Verify**: `supabase migration list --local` shows snapshot applied.

## P1 — Auth (Supabase, Google-only) + onboarding
- [ ] Env: add `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, service role server.
- [ ] `packages/auth`: rewrite to Supabase server/client init (replace
      better-auth). `src/lib/supabase-server.ts` + `supabase-client.ts`.
- [ ] Middleware/proxy `src/proxy.ts` auth-aware (session guard).
- [ ] `on_auth_user_created` trigger (SQL): Personal workspace + profile +
      owner membership + system groups (PERSONAL/SITE/WORKFLOWS/INVITES —
      INVITES locked empty).
- [ ] Root `page.tsx`: login (Google); post-signup onboarding questions flow
      driven by a JSON config (multi+single) → persist in `pre_answers`.
      Auto-navigate to onboarding if profile row is missing.
- **Verify**: Google login → Personal workspace exists → onboarding → workspace.

## P2 — New DB schema (see db/SCHEMA.md)
- [ ] `supabase migration new new_schema` → all 17 tables + enums + RLS +
      indexes + storage bucket `chat-attachments` + Realtime enabled for
      4 tables (chat_messages, run_activities, approval_requests,
      notifications). Tables incl. NEW: `groups`, `invites`, `thread_shares`;
      `workspace_members.role` = owner|editor|viewer (no admin).
- [ ] Group/thread limits enforced (≤5 threads/group, ≤3 groups/workspace
      free) via insert RPC/trigger.
- [ ] Drizzle types parity: regenerate `packages/db/src/schema` from new SQL.
- [ ] Drop legacy tables (auth/session/account/verification, webhook_board,
      agent_state, recovery_attempt, event, observation) in migration.
- [ ] `supabase db advisors` clean.
- **Verify**: advisors pass; RLS smoke test (anon/authenticated) via psql.

## P3 — Services (packages/workflow split; drop tRPC god router)
- [ ] `thread-service` (threads CRUD, search, title rename, bind, group move).
- [ ] `plan-service` (plans + plan_steps CRUD, accept/decline).
- [ ] `run-service` (runs lifecycle end-to-end + sequential queue drain).
- [ ] `activity-service` (run_activities insert/stream, sub-task nest).
- [ ] `notification-service` + `approval-service` + `key-service` (Vault +
      resolution: member-override → workspace → env).
- [ ] `member-service` (invites: workspace+thread, accept/fan-out, roles,
      revoke priorities re thread_shares).
- [ ] `memory-service` (mem0 ONE store per user, thread-metadata scoping,
      global = program-given).
- [ ] Remove `@aevryn/api` tRPC agent router usage (routes now REST/chat).
      Keep `GET /api/health` if wanted.
- **Verify**: services unit-tested against local Supabase (vitest).

## P4 — Inngest (rebuild functions directory)
- [ ] `thread/run` event + `thread-runner` (streaming run_activities, cost cap
      BEFORE steps, idempotent gate via `runs.status`).
- [ ] `schedule-tick` FIXED: real Inngest cron trigger + registered with all
      functions in `/api/inngest` serve.
- [ ] `notification-notifier` registered (webhook/in-app).
- [ ] Remove execution-run legacy + regex decision parsing; prompts centralized
      (`packages/agent/src/prompts.ts` per PROMPTS.md).
- **Verify**: `bun inngest:dev` + `bun dev` — run a sample delegation;
      `run_activities` rows appear; realtime arrives in UI.

## P5 — Chat route + live tools (the heart)
- [ ] `POST /api/chat` route: `streamText` + `ChatTransport`,
      `toUIMessageStream`, `createUIMessageStreamResponse`; session-aware;
      honor member key override before resolving workspace/env keys.
- [ ] Tools: `askQuestion`, `showPlan` (NO auto-plan — only on explicit
      user request), `editPlan`, `bindWorkflow`/`finalizeAndInject`,
      `storeMemory`, `searchMemory`, `httpRequest` (safe defaults),
      `delegateAgenticWork` (durable bridge), `listCapabilities`,
      `generateImage`/`transcribeAudio` (lazy per configured model).
- [ ] Tool schemas = zod; `AskUserQuestion` schema shared server/client.
- [ ] Auto-approve switch honored + system "auto-approved" msg.
- [ ] Attachments: image/pdf → LLM-readable parts (image data-URL, pdf text).
- [ ] Token `quality` slider = max tokens per chat request → `maxOutputTokens`.
- **Verify**: scenarios 1–3 from ARCHITECTURE §K pass end-to-end.

## P6 — Durable queue + attachments + product features
- [ ] `POST /api/queue` drain SEQUENTIALLY (deliver → wait finish → next);
      queued rows durable; ChatComposer reads DB queue; edit/reorder persists
      order + content.
- [ ] Image compression (canvas→WebP quality 0.8, ≤2000px) → storage → `files`.
- [ ] ChatMessage attachment props extended (`images/video/audio/pdf`).
- [ ] Soft-archive delete: `threads.deleted_at` set → trash UI (recover
      30 days) → purge job hard-deletes afterwards.
- [ ] Smart auto-title from first user message.
- [ ] Export/import thread (JSON, keys stripped).
- [ ] Re-run last run (runs.rerun_of, trigger=rerun, same plan, no new chat).
- [ ] Share preview page (title + owner only, no content pre-accept).
- **Verify**: close tab mid-queue + reopen → queue intact + delivers in order;
      trash recover works; rerun streams a fresh run.

## P7 — Frontend wiring (zustand + realtime + widgets)
- [ ] Stores: useAuthStore, useThreadStore, useComposerStore, useSidebarStore,
      useNotificationsStore, useUIStore.
- [ ] `useRealtimeThread(threadId)` subscription → merges broadcast rows.
- [ ] workspace/[threadId] page: real chat load, router push w/o reload,
      composer center→bottom, header real rename + workflow dropdown.
- [ ] AppSidebar: real NAV_SECTIONS (groups from DB incl. locked INVITES
      system group), search, notifications chip + mark-read, run-all/stop-all
      PARALLEL (groups ≤5), per-item run/stop/rename/share/delete.
- [ ] WorkflowDialog: rename Instructions→Agent + Environment tab + General/
      Share/Plan/Memories wired to real data; delete-confirm works.
      Environment tab = per-provider MODEL PRESETS (searchable) + free-text
      override. Share tab live (toggle, link, guests, revoke).
- [ ] Settings/Profile dialogs: Workspace group (General + Members) vs Global
      group (Notifications/Appearance/Security). Members: InputCopy link +
      list w/ role Select (owner/editor/viewer) + Remove. Profile: "use my own
      keys in invited workspaces" toggle.
- [ ] Invite UI: workspace link invite; thread share toggle list; Badge on
      thread button (INVITES group) + thread header; workspace switcher badge;
      share preview page.
- [ ] One-Run mental model: Run btn + LLM both fire `thread/run`; workflow
      approval dialog = 4 buttons max (Approve+Run/Approve/Decline/Edit plan).
- **Verify**: page-manual QA checklist (scenarios 4–8 in ARCHITECTURE §K).

## P8 — Sub-agents container + markdown (FUTURE phases, stubs designed)
- [ ] `run_activities.parent_id` sub-agent container merge (parallel).
- [ ] Markdown/table renderer (existing Table component; output contract ready).
- **Verify**: sub-agent demo.

## Commit plan (max 12, varied types — ≤ one phase per commit, each verifiable)
1. `chore(repo)`: gitignore `.codegraph/`, remove unused AGENTS_OLD.md
   (staged now).
2. `db(snapshot)`: freeze legacy schema + supabase config sanity (P0).
3. `db(schema)`: new 17-table schema, RLS, triggers, limits, realtime (P2).
4. `auth(init)`: supabase server/client, env vars, session proxy (P1).
5. `auth(login)`: Google-only login + JSON onboarding flow (P1).
6. `refactor(api)`: retire tRPC god router → REST + packages/workflow
   service split (P3 start).
7. `feat(services)`: thread/plan/run/member/key/memory services (P3).
8. `feat(inngest)`: thread-runner, schedule-tick, notifier, prompts central
   (P4).
9. `feat(chat)`: streaming `/api/chat` + live tools, NO auto-plan,
   attachments parts, token slider (P5).
10. `feat(queue)`: durable sequential delivery, image compression,
    soft-archive purge (P6).
11. `ui(app)`: zustand stores + realtime + sidebar/header/chat wired to DB,
    one-Run model (P7).
12. `ui(workspace)`: workflow dialog (Agent/Env presets/Share), settings
    split, invite UI, badges, share preview page (P7 tail).

## Definition of done (MVP)
- Google-only auth; JSON-driven onboarding; workspace membership (invites,
  owner/editor/viewer, all-threads-visible, key override toggle); thread
  sharing (INVITES group + badge, guest chat/run, own keys, owner revoke).
- Workspaces (Personal + joined) + threads + bound workflows via LLM tools only
  (NO auto-plan).
- Live chat streaming + durable Anakin runs streaming to ThinkingSteps.
- Queue durability (sequential) + auto-approve + notifications chip +
  per-workspace keys + media (image/transcription).
- No hardcoded mock data; all mocked UI wired to DB; tRPC removed.

275:

277: ```
278: role            : owner|editor|viewer          (workspace_members)
279: thread_role     : editor|viewer                (thread_shares / invites; no owner row — owner = threads.user_id)
280: plan            : free|pro
281: group_kind      : custom|system
282: invite_kind     : workspace|thread
283: invite_status   : pending|accepted|revoked|expired
284: workflow_status : waiting|planning|running|awaiting_approval|idle|paused|failed|completed
285: message_role    : user|assistant|system|tool
286: message_status  : queued|streaming|completed|failed|interrupted
287: run_status      : pending|running|sleeping|waiting|awaiting_approval|completed|failed|cancelled
288: activity_status : pending|active|complete|failed
289: activity_type   : tool|thinking|task|subtask|system
290: approval_status : pending|approved|denied
291: api_provider    : groq|anakin|mem0|image|speech|transcription|video
292: ```
293: 
294: ## Supabase specifics
295: - Migrations via `supabase migration new <name>` (imperative workflow).
296: - **Realtime**: enable on `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
297:   `approval_requests`, `notifications` with private channels + JWT auth.
298: - **Storage bucket**: `chat-attachments` — create server-side w/ service role;
299:   dedicated policy `(storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text` for
300:   CUD. Policy for avatar/object keys too.
301: - **RLS policy list**:
302:   - owner-only tables: user_profiles, notifications, workspace_api_keys,
303:     files (+ own invites).
304:   - workspace-scoped: workspaces, groups, threads, workflows, plans,
305:     chat_messages, runs, run_activities, approval_requests → readable by owner
306:     OR any `workspace_members` row (all threads visible to members).
307:   - cross-workspace thread access: `threads` also readable via a matching
308:     `thread_shares` row (invitee; in their OWN workspace context / INVITES
309:     group). Never bundled into a shared-workspace read.
310:   - `workspace_api_keys`: SELECT only via `security definer` RPC
311:     `get_workspace_key(workspace_id, provider)` that validates <owner OR
312:     workspace_members> and decrypts server-side (service role decrypt NOT
313:     exposed). Member key resolution honors `user_profiles.prefer_own_keys_in_shared`
314:     → falls back to the member's OWN Personal workspace keys.
315: - **Oracle triggers**: `on_auth_user_created` → insert
316:   `workspaces(Personal)` (is_default) + `user_profiles` row +
317:   `workspace_members(owner)` for that workspace + system `groups`
318:   (PERSONAL, SITE, WORKFLOWS, INVITES — INVITES locked empty) automatically.
319: 
320: ## Why this shape (reasoning)
321: - `threads` + `workflows` split: a chat exists before any plan/bind; binding
322:   sets `threads.bound_workflow_id`. MVP single-workspace but multi-thread.
323: - `groups` = the sidebar folder concept the plan asks for (New button → new
324:   custom group; INVITES is a LOCKED system group created at signup — empty
325:   until a thread invite is accepted). Group/thread limits (≤5 threads/group,
326:   ≤3 custom groups/workspace free) enforced at insert.
327: - `invites` unified (workspace | thread) keeps one token/status/expiry flow;
328:   accept fans out to `workspace_members` or `thread_shares`.
329: - `thread_shares` = invited guests only; role editor/viewer — guests get chat/
330:   run/approve but never plan-edit/rename/re-share (owner-only rights stay on
331:   `threads.user_id`).
332: - `runs` separate from workflow status: each durable pass is auditable,
333:   replayable, cancellable; activity tables hang off `run_id`.
334: - `run_activities` replaces old `event`/`observation`/`agent_state` — shaped
335:   directly for the ThinkingSteps/ToolStep UI components and realtime push,
336:   killing the god-table smell.
337: - `chat_messages` owns history (requirement: no hardcoded mock); queue solved
338:   by `status=queued` rows — durable across page close/reload.
339: - Plain user-supplied keys isolated in ONE table (never in env, never client)
340:   → the "Agent/Environment" dialog writes here.

(End of file - total 340 lines)
